newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U reverses closure of haemophilia project.
newsitem.headline: P&U reverses closure of haemophilia project.

text.p: U.S./Swedish drugs company Pharmacia & Upjohn said on Friday that it was reversing an earlier decision to close its haemophilia research project.
Company spokesman Soren Densjo said P&U had decided to restart discussions to find a partner for the project.
"The discussions that we were in before will be continued," Densjo told Reuters.
P&U said last month that it was abandoning its research into a treatment for haemophilia because it could not find a partner for the project.
"The reactions we have received from patients, patient organisations and doctors have convinced us that an opening can be found," Densjo said.
He said a problem over the patent for the treatment had also put a question market over the project.
"The patent issue is an important part. An opening there can give an opening for other things," he said.
Densjo said nothing new had come up on this front.
"But the reactions we received show it is logical to continue discussion," Densjo said.
